outcome: Quality of maternal and newborn care
cohort: 5003 women who gave birth in Sweden between March 1, 2020 and June 30, 2021
finding: Considerable gaps in quality of care and deviations from women-centred care were noted during the COVID-19 pandemic, particularly among women who underwent prelabor Cesarean section.
mod_finding: Women undergoing prelabor Cesarean section perceived poorer quality of maternal and newborn care compared to those who had vaginal deliveries or emergency Cesarean sections.
